notes: Fire: engine.fire screening zone model (t² growth capped by fuel and air, NFPA 92 plume, one smoke layer per room, buoyant door spill, ISO 13571-style untenability: layer below 2 m or above 200 °C). Flashover at Thomas's Q_fo or an upper layer of 600 °C (Peacock et al. 1999), whichever comes first; after it, fire spreads as engine.fire sets out. No sprinklers, smoke control or fire service: a worst-case pre-plan.

Room of origin: untenable once the fire radiates 2.5 kW/m² (ISO 13571) at 3 m, a point source with radiative fraction 0.3: about 942 kW, 2:22 into a fast fire. The zone model alone keeps a room that vents into a big neighbour tenable much longer.

Skylight wells: each open_to_below space and the 1F spaces under it are ONE fire room, modelled as a box with the true top (the skylights) and the true volume, so its floor area is volume / height. 2F well edges are doors of that room at the 2F level.
Step bands: two indoor spaces joined by a `step` opening (no wall, no door: 140 and 150) are one fire room the same way.
Spaces inside a merged room are judged from their own floor and ceiling (the Galleria far end at +0.62 m, 150 at +0.70 m), from the room's layer at 1 s steps.
Door tops sit at the real header height above the higher floor (150's opening to the Galleria tops out at 3.7 m). Outside merged rooms the fire model still uses one elevation per storey.
Unprotected interior stairs between two ordinary rooms are stair shafts (open at both ends); stair 100ST, inside a well, is an open 2F door of the atrium.
Outdoor spaces and SAFE are outside: smoke vents there and they never block.
Exterior doors are closed for smoke (no venting) but usable for egress. A room of origin with no open opening at all gets its doors opened, or the fire would starve.
Elevators: not egress; landing doors closed (60 min); the hoistway carries no smoke.

Routes walk door to door at the SFPE free speed (1.20 m/s level, 0.92 m/s along 7/11 stairs). A route must cross each opening before it is blocked and enter each space before it is blocked; a space blocked at departure is trapped. No pre-movement delay: the departure time is when people start moving.

Each space's occupant_load moves as a group. Openings pass at most 1.3 people/s per metre of effective width (1.01 on stairs, SFPE). Aria's plan books door and stair time group by group (greedy CCRP) and keeps the best of four candidate plans; reactive groups queue first come, first served. People still queued when an opening closes are at risk.
Cut-offs and margins under 10 s are flagged marginal: inside the models' timing error.
